description: Implementation of Http2HeaderBlock class for managing HTTP/2 headers, including storage, manipulation, and serialization.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock
classes.description: Represents a collection of HTTP/2 headers with methods for manipulation and serialization.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock::HeaderValue
classes.description: Stores individual header values, supporting appending fragments and consolidating values.

classes.name: Http2HeaderBlock::ValueProxy
classes.description: Proxy object for header value access and modification via operator[].

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the header block.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the header block for debugging.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::operator[]
methods.description: Accesses or creates a header value proxy for a given key.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::AppendValueOrAddHeader
methods.description: Appends to an existing header or adds a new header.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::AppendHeader
methods.description: Adds a new header with specified key and value.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::WriteKey
methods.description: Stores the key in storage and returns a string view.

methods.name: Http2HeaderBlock::bytes_allocated
methods.description: Returns total bytes allocated in storage.
